summary: Iteration 12 Complete: Enhanced Devices Page + Device Detail Page with 7 tabs - All 16 backend tests passed, all 15 frontend features verified working

issues: Console warnings about chart width/height being -1, but charts render correctly after DOM stabilizes

passed_tests: === Backend API Tests (16/16 passed) ===
GET /api/devices - returns list of 10 devices with all required fields
GET /api/devices - devices have: id, name, client_name, os, ip_address, cpu_usage, memory_usage, disk_usage, compliance_score, last_seen, status, device_type
GET /api/devices/stats/summary - returns total: 10, online: 8, offline: 1, warning: 1, avg_cpu, needs_patching
GET /api/devices/dev-001/detail - returns device + software + patches + events + performance + network_adapters
GET /api/devices/dev-001/detail - device has hardware specs (manufacturer, model, serial_number, processor, ram_gb, storage_total_gb)
GET /api/devices/dev-001/detail - device has security fields (antivirus, antivirus_status, firewall_enabled, encryption_status, compliance_score)
GET /api/devices/dev-001/software - returns 8 software entries with name, version, publisher, category
GET /api/devices/dev-001/patches - returns 4 patches with kb_id, title, severity, status
GET /api/devices/dev-001/events - returns 11 events with event_type, message, timestamp, severity
GET /api/devices/dev-001/performance - returns 288 data points with cpu, memory, disk, timestamp
GET /api/devices/dev-001/detail - network_adapters has 2 entries with adapter_name, ip_address, type
POST /api/devices - creates device successfully
GET /api/devices/dev-001 - returns single device by ID
GET /api/devices/non-existent - returns 404 for missing device
GET /api/devices?status=online - filter by status works
GET /api/devices?client_id=xxx - filter by client works
=== Frontend UI Tests (15/15 passed) ===
Devices List Page loads with header 'Devices' and subtitle '10 managed endpoints'
Stats cards visible: Total (10), Online (8), Offline (1), Warning (1), Avg CPU (33.8%), Need Patching (6)
Table view shows 10 device rows with all columns (Device, Client, OS, IP, CPU, RAM, Disk, Compliance, Last Seen)
Grid view toggle works - shows 10 device cards with CPU/RAM/Disk usage bars and tags
Search filter works - 'ACME' filters to 4 rows
Status filter works - 'Online' shows filtered results
Clicking device row navigates to /devices/dev-001
Device Detail page shows device name (ACME-DC-01), status badge (online), compliance badge (95%)
Overview Tab: Hardware Specs (Dell PowerEdge R740, 128GB RAM, 3600GB storage), OS info, Assignment, Tags, Security Status, Recent Activity
Performance Tab: 4 charts (CPU/Memory/Disk/Network I/O over 24h) with real data
Software Tab: 8 software entries with version, publisher, category, install date, size
Patches Tab: 4 patches with KB IDs, severity badges (Critical/Important), status badges (Installed/Pending)
Security Tab: Compliance Score visible, Endpoint Protection section, Patch Compliance section
Network Tab: Internal/Public IP cards, MAC Address, Network Adapters table with 2 adapters
Events Tab: 11 events with event type icons, messages, severity badges, timestamps
Back button returns to /devices list
Add Device dialog opens with all form fields (name, client, type, OS, IP, manufacturer, model, etc.)
seed_data_creation: No new seed data created - using existing 10 devices (dev-001 through dev-010)
